title: 第九章 有骨气【收藏推荐月票】
content_zh: 想起来这件事，孙元就长吁短叹。以往每次看到有些高手老东西在长吁短叹，抱怨什么‘徒儿太天才了、做师父没啥意思’这种话，孙元若不是打不过，必然要冲上去打死这些装逼犯！特么还能更无耻一些？不过走了狗屎运收了个天才徒弟，就不知道东南西北了？天天出来装逼，居然还有脸叹气。咋不去死？但现在，他真正理解了那些人的心情。因为……方彻的天才程度，比起那帮老家伙吹牛中的天才徒弟们，有过之而无不及！自己的毕生所学，刀法剑法拳法步法脚法……自己只要打一遍，方彻就能立即复制。练习三遍之后，就算按自己这个练了几十年的老东西的标准，也挑不出半点毛病。甚至还隐约感觉徒儿领悟的，比自己的还要正规些……你说这找谁说理去？更难一些的心法步法刀法之间的配合，也不过是三五遍练习的事情，就能纯熟上手。甚至不需要孙元矫正，方彻打完一遍自己站在那思考一下子，接着再打第二次，就能将上一次出现的小毛病都改正过来。孙元感觉自己这个师父就是个摆设。没半点用处。别人当师父都能逮住徒弟臭骂一顿，然后指出不足。但是自己连不足都看不出来，甚至还有‘要不要跟着徒弟学一下’这种想法——师道尊严何在？收徒四天。第一天下午教授心法，还没到晚上方彻已经根据心法练出来了元灵之气！而且在丹田形成气漩。到晚上教授刀法，四套成名刀法各练了一遍。还没过子时，方彻已经持刀霍霍而舞。连每一套刀法的步法身法配合，都是丝毫不差。让自己在之前说的‘我以这套刀法享誉江湖，博得刀王之名，如今传授于你，切不可轻忽。’这种话，彻底成了笑话。勉强到了第三天，孙元一辈子本事就被方彻掏了个底朝天。除了力度还不行，其他熟练度，以及正确性，都已经无懈可击，挑不出半点毛病。但力度、战斗经验，这些可不是熟练度。这需要长年累月的练功，水磨工夫。孙元这次秘密回教，直接进了长老供奉院。这是一心教最秘密的所在。所有在这里面的长老，都是在外面不暴露真正身份的那种。而孙元便是其中的一位三级供奉。孙元进去之后就去找几位前辈供奉道歉。“之前是我错了。误解了几位前辈，今日特来道歉。”几個人纳闷。这货是吃错药了？怎么突然来道歉了？哪得罪我们了？“误解啥了？”“之前我不明白情况，今日始知这个世界上，真的有天才存在。”孙元道：“之前见几位前辈说起来徒弟太天才，实在是让人难受，晚辈不知，所以心中颇有微词，但近日，晚辈自己收了个弟子，才明白诸位前辈当时乃是肺腑之言。”“？？？”“哎，实在是难，晚辈一生所学，三天便被掏空，功法一天入门出气漩，武学招式，一个时辰就能打的比我自己还标准。”孙元怅怅叹息：“我这个做师父的毫无成就感，甚至有时候，还感觉应该跟徒弟学习一下……然后我才明白，诸位前辈之前的惆怅，那是何等的发自内心啊……”说着连连摇头，负手而立，一脸惆怅，无语，加上落寞。三个一级供奉面面相觑：“……”只感觉一股火骤然升起。原来这小子是来装逼的！我们那些天才弟子，招式也需要五六天还达不到完全标准，功法半月入门当时都感觉旷古绝今了。现在居然出来一个能一个时辰入门的。顿时三个老家伙皮笑肉不笑：“是嘛？既然这么没有成就感，这么烦，不如让给我做徒弟好了。”孙元愣了愣，干笑道：“那还是不劳烦各位前……”“不麻烦！我们很乐意替你受苦。”“不了不了……”“……打他！”孙元是逃出来的。落荒而逃。这帮老家伙下手极为没有分寸，孙元实力又弱了些，被打的两个眼眶都黑了，脑袋上还有几个大包。受伤最严重的当然是嘴。整个儿都变成了猪嘴。这是在教育他：以后记住，这是嘴，别装逼。装逼会挨揍的。导致去任务堂申请任务的时候被围观了。“啧，这是被灭门仇人找上门了？”“估计是抢了人家老婆被当场撞破。”“……”孙元一脸黑线进了内堂去找教主。“教主，那个任务的事。”“任务没问题。”教主脸色有些奇异：“贡献点也没啥问题。但是……你这炫耀的也太那啥了吧？”孙元：“我……”
content_en: Thinking of this incident, Sun Yuan sighed.In the past, every time I saw some old masters sighing and complaining about things like, 'The disciple is too talented and being a master is meaningless.How could it be more shameless?But just because you were lucky enough to have a talented apprentice, you don’t know what’s going on?I come out to show off every day, but I still have the nerve to sigh.Why don't you die?But now, he truly understood the mood of those people.Because... Fang Che's level of genius is even worse than the genius disciples boasted by those old guys!What he has learned all his life, swordsmanship, swordsmanship, boxing, footwork and kicks... As long as he fights them once, Fang Che can copy them immediately.After practicing it three times, even by my standards as an old guy who has been practicing for decades, I can't find any faults.I even have a vague feeling that my disciple's understanding is more formal than my own... Who do you think you can talk to to reason with this?The more difficult coordination between mental techniques, footwork, and sword techniques only requires three or five times of practice before you can master them.Sun Yuan didn't even need to correct him. After Fang Che had beaten him once, he stood there and thought for a while, and then he beat him a second time, and he was able to correct all the minor problems that occurred last time.Sun Yuan felt that his master was just a decoration.It's of no use at all.When someone else is a master, they can catch their disciples, scold them, and then point out their shortcomings.But I can't even see my shortcomings, and I even have the idea of ​​"should I learn from my apprentice" - where is the dignity of a teacher?Take on a disciple for four days.In the afternoon of the first day, the mental method was taught. Before the evening, Fang Che had already practiced Yuanling Qi based on the mental method!And a whirlpool of energy is formed in the Dantian.In the evening, I taught swordsmanship and practiced each of the four sets of famous swordsmanship.Before it was too late, Fang Che was already dancing with a knife.Even the footwork and body coordination of each set of sword techniques are exactly the same.Let yourself say before, 'I am famous in the world for this set of sword skills and have won the name of the King of Swordsmen. Now I teach it to you. Don't ignore it.’ This kind of statement has completely become a joke.On the third day, Sun Yuan's life skills were completely destroyed by Fang Che.Except for the lack of strength, other proficiency and accuracy are already impeccable, and there is no fault at all.But strength and combat experience are not proficiency.This requires years of practice and hard work.Sun Yuan secretly converted to Islam this time and went directly to the Elders' Worship Hall.This is the most secret place of Yixin Sect.All the elders here are the kind who do not reveal their true identities outside.And Sun Yuan is one of the third-level worshipers.After Sun Yuan entered, he went to find several seniors to offer sacrifices and apologize."I was wrong before. I misunderstood several seniors, and I am here to apologize today." Several people were puzzled.Did this guy take the wrong medicine?Why did you suddenly apologize?What offended us?"What's the misunderstanding?" "I didn't understand the situation before, but today I know that geniuses really exist in this world." Sun Yuandao said: "It was really uncomfortable when I saw several seniors talking about my apprentice being too talented. I don't know this, so I was quite critical in my heart. But recently, I accepted a disciple myself, and I realized that the seniors were speaking from the bottom of their hearts." "???"After learning the Qi Whirlpool in one day, and the martial arts moves in an hour, I was able to perform better than myself." Sun Yuan sighed sadly: "As a master, I have no sense of accomplishment.Sometimes, I even feel that.I feel like I should learn from my apprentice... Then I realized how the melancholy of the seniors came from the bottom of their hearts..." As he spoke, he shook his head repeatedly and stood with his hands behind his back, looking melancholy, speechless, and lonely.The three first-level worshipers looked at each other: "..." They felt a fire suddenly rise.It turns out this guy is here to show off!For our talented disciples, it takes five or six days for our moves to reach the full standard, and even after half a month of learning the techniques, they feel unprecedented.Now there is someone who can get started in an hour.Suddenly the three old guys were laughing but not smiling at all: "Really? Since you are so unfulfilled and so annoying, you might as well become my apprentice." Sun Yuan was stunned for a moment, then laughed dryly and said: "It's better not to bother you all..." "No trouble! We are happy to suffer for you." "Nothing can be done..." "...beat him!" Sun Yuan escaped.Flee in despair.These old guys were extremely careless in their attacks, and Sun Yuan was a little weaker. His two eye sockets were black after being beaten, and there were several big bumps on his head.The most serious injury was of course the mouth.The whole thing turned into a pig's mouth.This is to educate him: remember in the future, this is your mouth, don’t pretend to be cool.You'll get beaten if you show off.As a result, I was surrounded when I went to the mission hall to apply for a mission."Tsk, is this the enemy who destroyed the family?" "I guess he robbed his wife and was caught on the spot." "..." Sun Yuan entered the inner hall to find the leader with a dark look on his face."Leader, it's about the mission." "The mission is no problem." The leader looked a little strange: "It's okay to contribute a little bit. But... you're showing off too much, right?" Sun Yuan: "I..."
